newsitem.title: ITALY: ITALY SHARES START DOWN THEN RECOUP AFTER DOW DROP.
newsitem.headline: ITALY SHARES START DOWN THEN RECOUP AFTER DOW DROP.

text.p: Italian shares started lower after the Dow's near 200 point fall after comments by Japan's prime minister Ryutaro Hashimoto on the potential sale by Japan of U.S. government securities triggered a wave of profit-taking.
* The All-share Mibtel index which opened 0.74 percent off at 13,219 recovered to stand 0.3 percent down at 13,277 at 0808 GMT.
* The Mib30 blue chip index, after opening 0.76 percent lower at 20,083, was 0.22 percent off at 20,191.
